cases.reason: Both LINE formats are identical in both editions, and SR1 sits under ALL FORMATS in both. The report leg is mandatory in 2002 (report writer is no optional module there) and the compiler implements it identically (reader's byte-identical reports). The screen leg reaches the 2002 screen section, which 2002 B.3 item 1 makes processor-dependent; 3.1.5 lets the implementor not claim it provided it warns at compile time, and the compiler refuses screen syntax by name at 2002. So no part of the 2002 scope lacks evidence or a license. Residual: the refusal text cites only the 2023 licence, a message issue, not this rule.
